Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That's it from the coverage of this game. More cricketing action coming your way as Sri Lanka take on the United Arab Emirates in the second match of the doubleheader. The action starts at 1.30 pm IST (8 am GMT) but you can switch tabs and follow the build-up to that game right away. Cheers!

Scott Edwards, the captain of the Netherlands says that they don't wanna be known as the team that leaves it late but is stoked with the win. Adds that they did well to get the runs at the top and they knew Namibia had strong death bowlers but they managed to get over the line and is happy with the opportunity they have given themselves to make the next round.

The skipper of Namibia, Gerhard Erasmus says that they could not keep things tight in the field which made it easier for the opposition. He says that they lacked with the blade, and probably even Netherlands struggled with the same but they ran well.

Bas de Leede is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his match-winning effort with both bat and ball. He starts by jokingly saying that some of his teammates might be bitter about him snatching most of the wickets. He says the self belief has always been there and adds that it feels really good to clinch two close games and it does really well for their side.
The Presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Gerhard Erasmus won the toss and elected to bat first which didn't turn out well as they lost as many as 3 wickets inside the Powerplay. It was then a steady knock played by Jan Frylinck that kept them in the game but they could only manage to put on 121 runs on the board. The Netherlands bowled extremely well as a group just like they did in the first game. In reply, Netherlands got off to a flier thanks to Vikramjit Singh and even after Namibia were able to pick up wickets towards the end and the game got close, Bas de Leede ensured that his side got over the line.

The Namibian new ball bowlers were not as effective as their counterparts. Just when Netherlands were running away with the game though, Namibia clawed their way back into the game with quick wickets. Namibia gave it their all but just didn’t have enough runs in the bank for their bowlers to defend and will now have to win their final game if they are to have a strong chance of making it through to the next round.

What an incredible finish to the game but it is Netherlands who hold their nerves and make it 2 wins out of 2 to go top of the group table. Max O'Dowd and Vikramjit Singh provided a great start for Netherlands in their pursuit of 122. The opening pair stitched a 59-run partnership. Despite a mini collapse towards the end, Bas de Leede steadied the ship and saw Netherlands home courtesy of his unbeaten knock.

That's it, Bas de Leede holds his nerves and hits the winning run. This is full and straight, de Leeded manages to punch it back past the bowler and the ball goes dead straight. The fielder from long on comes across but the batters are able to get back for two. Netherlands win by 5 wickets!
A quick bumper now from David Wiese, Bas de Leede walks towards the ball and lets it through. Bas de Leede thinks its too high but the umpire deems it a fair delivery.

FOUR! That should do it for Netherlands. Good length, outside off. Bas de Leede backs away and thumps it over the mid off. The ball goes off the toe end but has enough on it to clear the fielder and the ball trickles into the fence as well. Just 2 needed now off 5 deliveries.

Full and outside off, Tim Pringle stays deep in his crease and manages to loft it over the cover region. The fielder from inside the ring chases it down and keeps it down to two. 6 needed now off 6 deliveries.
Back of a length, over middle and leg, this is jabbed away in front of deep mid-wicket for just another single.

Tim Pringle has flattened the stumps at the other end. Length ball on off stump, Pringle hits it towards mid off and sets off for the single. Gerhard Erasmus has a shy at the bowler's end as Pringle dives it. The fielder misses the stumps but Pringle just barges into them.
Just over! Full and angling into leg stump, Tim Pringle chips this one using his wrists and the ball just eludes the leaping fielder at short mid-wicket. The batters pick up a couple of runs as well.
Fuller and outside off, Bas de Leede walks towards the ball and plays it on the up towards deep cover for one more.
Misfield and they do get the single. Good length, at the stumps, Tim Pringle flicks it to the left of short mid-wicket who slides across but misses the ball and allows the single.
Fullish length, angling it into off stump, Tim Pringle just pushes it out on the off side and collects a single. 14 needed now off 12 balls.
A full toss now, outside off, Bas de Leede walks across once again and clips it away towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Slower delivery, on a length and outside off. Bas de Leede shuffles across and just nudges it towards the vacant mid-on region. They push hard for two and get it with ease, good running.
Tim Pringle hangs back to this length ball and guides it towards backward point for a single.
A dot now! It is a length ball, this one nips in off the deck. Tim Pringle hangs back and blocks it back to the bowler.
A single this time! Full length, wide of off. Bas de Leede shuffles across and pushes it towards covers. One taken.
Would you believe it! A wicket-maiden in the 17th over, take a bow Jan Frylinck! Full and around off, Tim Pringle defends it out.
Slower again, shorter as well and outside off. Tim Pringle looks to cut but misses and the pressure just keep on mounting.
Tim Pringle is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another bites the dust and Namibia might just pull off the unthinkable here. Another slower delivery by Jan Frylinck, on a length this time and around off. The ball gets stuck in the pitch a bit. Scott Edwards is caught by surprise and just sticks out his willow towards the ball. The ball hits the shoulder of the bat and lobs off towards short cover where Nicol Loftie-Eaton takes a simple catch. 20 needed now off 20 deliveries.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicol Loftie-Eaton b Jan Frylinck

Commentary.Commentary: Slower one, full and outside off as well. Three dots in a row as Scott Edwards only manages to squeeze it out on the off side.
Shorter this time, around the body. Scott Edwards chops it towards backward point and there's no single there yet again.
Back of a length and outside off, Scott Edwards waits for it and dabs it towards backward point.
Good length, on the pads, this is worked away towards mid-wicket for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Straight to the man and Netherlands losing the plot a bit here. JJ Smit bowls it full and on off stump. Colin Ackermann has to go for the lofted shot as the fielders are in tightly, saving the single. Ackermann drives it down the ground but gets no sort of elevation on it. The ball goes hard and towards the Namibian skipper, Gerhard Erasmus who takes a sharp catch at mid off. Ackermann departs for a duck and JJ Smit gets two wickets in the same over. Also, Scott Edwards is the new man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Gerhard Erasmus b JJ Smit

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and on off stump, Colin Ackermann defends it out.

OUT! CAUGHT! An unnecessary shot from Tom Cooper and Netherlands lose their third wicket. This is shorter and around the body. Cooper looks to take it on and goes for the aerial pull. Cooper doesn't get enough on it and the ball goes towards the fielder on the mid-wicket fence. Michael Van Lingen over there doesn't have to move an inch and pouches it safely. JJ Smit gives his team another chance and now, 21 runs are needed off 27 balls. Also, Colin Ackermann walks out to bat.
Commentary.Howout: c Michael Van Lingen b JJ Smit

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Up and over! This will release the pressure. Fullish delivery, around off, Tom Cooper stands tall and thumps it over extra cover for a boundary.
Length ball, slower and close to the off stump. Bas de Leede just bunts it out towards cover for a quick single.

Exceptional fielding inside the circle! It is full, outside off. Cooper drives it to covers. The fielder there dives to his right and makes a great stop to save a single this time. 26 runs needed in 30 balls now.
Bas de Leede now works this length delivery to mid off. One taken.
A length ball, on off. Cooper smacks it to mid off. Fortunately it meets the fielder on a bounce.They cross for one.
It is full, wide of off. This one stays pretty low after hitting the deck. Tom Cooper fails to find any connection.
Bas de Leede hangs back to this good-length delivery and punches it through the gap at covers for another single.
Cooper gets off the mark with a single, as this is pushed gently towards covers.
Jan Frylinck (2-0-12-0) comes back into the attack.
Tosses it up, on off, blocked out.
Tom Cooper walks in at number 4.

OUT! RUN OUT! Namibia get a wicket against the run of play here. Unfortunate for Max O'Dowd as his bats gets stuck in the deck while scmapering towards the other end. It is much fuller, on off stump. Max O'Dowd gets it out to mid off. He calls for the single and takes off. Gerhard Erasmus charges towards the ball and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. Max O'Dowd's bat fell outside the crease and he could not make it in time. The same is confirmed by the third umpire. Is there a twist in the tale?

Is that a run-out? Max O'Dowd is walking away but the umpires have gone upstairs. Gerhard Erasmus scores a direct-hit at the non-striker's end and the replays confirm that Max O'Dowd is well short. OUT!
Bas de Leede smashes this length ball down to long off for one more. This is smart batting from the Dutch.
Max O'Dowd goes down leg and Smit follows him with a length ball. Max O'Dowd flicks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Another dot now! This is a length ball, in the channel. Max O'Dowd taps it to point.
Good length, on middle and leg. Max O'Dowd goes back and blocks it into the deck/
Fuller, on middle and leg. Bas de Leede nudges it into the free space at mid-wicket and scampers across for two runs.
Floated and full, on off. Bas de Leede defends it out to safety.
Pushed through quicker, in line with the stumps. Max O'Dowd stays back and taps it to covers for a quick single.
Another single now, as Bas de Leede clips it to mid-wicket.
Aimed at the stumps this time. Max O'Dowd eases it to long off for another run.
Tossed up, on off. Bas de Leede comes down the track and hits it to long off for one.
Flatter, outside off. Max O'Dowd cuts it to point off his back foot.
Bas de Leede could not capitalize on the Free Hit. Only a single as the ball is pushed down to long off.
NO BALL! There is an appeal for stumping, although it does not go well for Namibia as the third umpire says it is a no ball. Free Hit coming up.
Good running! Another quick single now. It is tossed up, on off. Max O'Dowd gets it to the leg side off the inner half. One taken.
On the pads, Bas de Leede flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Timed to perfection. Bas de Leede getting into the act now. It is fuller, outside off. Bas de Leede slashes it through covers for a boundary.
Quicker and full, on middle and leg. Bas de Leede defends it back to the bowler.
On off, defended out. 8 runs off the over. Netherlands are cruising at the moment.

SIX! Max O'Dowd gets enough power on it to beat the man in the deep. It is short, on middle. Max O'Dowd opens his body and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder near the ropes leaps but is unable to gather the ball. Maximum.
Two dots on the trot now! This is floated, on leg stump. The ball dies off the deck. Max O'Dowd looks to whip it away but takes a blow on his thigh pads.
Pushed through quicker and on off. Max O'Dowd defends it out.
This is full, on the stumps. Bas de Leede makes room and pushes it gently towards cover for one.
Fuller, on off. Max O'Dowd drives it to point for a single.

Drinks break! Netherlands got off to an exceptional start courtesy of Vikramjit Singh who took on the bowlers inside the Powerplay. Namibia though have been able to pull back things since then but are still chasing the game. It is all about game management from here on for Netherlands and they should get over the line with ease. With 54 runs needed off 60 deliveries, Namibia need some magic from their bowlers to win this one.
Slower delivery, Max O'Dowd flicks it to deep square-leg and takes a single.

Good length on the off-stump, Bas de Leede pushes it to mid off and sets off for a single. He doesn't slide the bat, gets stuck in the ground at the non-striker's end. Had the fielder hit, Bas de Leede was gone.
Slower delivery at the stumps, Max O'Dowd flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Slower delivery outside off, Max O'Dowd makes room and slashes it over backward point for a boundary, First boundary for Max O'Dowd.
Good length delivery outside off, Bas de Leede drives it to deep cover for a single.
Good-length delivery outside off, Bas de Leede pushes it to mid-wicket.
A single to end the over and just 2 runs and a wicket come off it. Short and outside off, cut away towards deep cover by Bas de Leede for one.
Flighted once again, on off stump and this is just eased back to the bowler.
On the shorter side, this is nudged away towards mid-wicket.
Nicely flighted, on middle and leg, Bas de Leede pushes it back to the bowler.
Bas de Leede comes in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Vikramjit Singh finds the fielder in the deep and Namibia have the breakthrough they so desperately wanted. Bernard Scholtz drops it a tad short and around leg stump. Singh goes deep in his crease but gets cramped for room. Singh forces the pull shot and hits it hard and flat. The ball goes towards Nicol Loftie-Eaton at the mid-wicket fence and he takes a sharp catch. Singh departs after providing a brisk start to his team.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicol Loftie-Eaton b Bernard Scholtz

Commentary.Commentary: Bernard Scholtz comes back into the attack and starts off with a full delivery around off. Max O'Dowd eases it down to long off for a single.
Short outside off, Max O'Dowd cuts it to deep point for a single.
Full on the middle stump, Vikramjit Singh flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted on the leg stump, Vikramjit Singh gets beaten on the sweep. A loud shout for LBW by the bowler but the umpire isn't interested. They think of a review but decide not to go upstairs.
Flighted delivery yet again, Vikramjit Singh drives it back to the bowler.
Flighted outside off, Max O'Dowd drives it to long off for a single.
Flighted on the middle stump, Max O'Dowd reverse sweeps but can only find short third-man.
On the shorter side and well outside off, Max O'Dowd cuts it square towards sweeper cover for a run.
Slower again, fuller too and around off. The ball just sticks in the surface a bit and produces the false block from Max O'Dowd.
Slower one, on a good length and around off. Singh punches it down to long off for a single.
Good length, pushed outside off, Max O'Dowd hangs back and slashes it towards deep point for a run.
Fullish length again, around off, Singh waits for it and nudges it towards backward point for a single.
Jan Frylinck comes on to bowl and starts off with a fullish delivery on off stump. Vikramjit Singh pushes it towards mid on.
Flighted on the off stump, Max O'Dowd goes inside out over extra cover for a couple of runs. The 50-run stand comes up between these two.
Flatter delivery on the off-stump, Vikramjit Singh cuts it on the offside for a single.
Full on the pads, Max O'Dowd flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Short on the off-stump, Max O'Dowd makes room and cuts it to the right of the cover point. David Wiese dives to his right but cannot prevent the double.
Flighted on the middle stump, Vikramjit Singh rolls his wrist and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted outside off, Vikramjit Singh gets beaten on the sweep.
This one is angled into the pads, on a length. Max O'Dowd nudges it to mid-wicket and denies for the single. So, two dots on the trot to end the over, still 8 runs come off it.
A length ball, wide of off. The ball dies as it reaches the keeper. Max O'Dowd hangs back and looks to cut it away but gets undone by the pace.
There is a slight halt in play as David Wiese seems to have cut himself on the forehead. The physio is out and patches him up and we are good to continue.

IN THE AIR...SAFE! It is fuller, on the pads, Max O'Dowd uses his feet and flicks it aerially over mid-wicket. He does not time it well. David Wiese turns around and charges towards the ball. He is quick but not quick enough on this occasion as the ball lands safely. The batters cross for a couple.
Fuller, outside off. Singh smashes it towards sweeper cover. There is protection in the deep and they take a single.

FOUR! What a shot! Vikramjit Singh is on a roll here. It is a length ball, in the channel. Vikramjit Singh stays leg side of the ball and drives it through covers. A fielder gives it a chase but the ball wins the race.
A single to start with! A good-length ball, on off. Max O'Dowd gets an inside edge as he looks to pull it away. The batters sneak a quick single.
SIX! Consecutive sixes for Vikramjit Singh. Flicks it towards deep square-leg for a maximum.
SIX! Crunched! Ben Shikongo drops it short and Vikramjit Singh pulls it off the backfoot to deep mid-wicket for a massive six.
Wide! Ben Shikongo sprays it down the leg side and it is wided.
Good delivery by Ben Shikongo. Follows the batsman as he makes room. The batsman defends it back to the bowler.
Back of a length and outside off, Vikramjit Singh plays it off the back foot and through cover-point for a couple of runs more.

Full outside off, Vikramjit Singh smashes it over wide mid on but the ball doesn't travel the distance as it plugs in the outfield. Singh is just standing there admiring his shot but then scampers through for two.
Short outside off, Max O'Dowd pulls it to the left of the mid-wicket fielder. The fielder dives to his left but cannot save the single.
Loops it up, on off. Singh defends it back to the bowler on the front foot.
Another single now as Max O'Dowd sweeps it to deep square leg. Max O'Dowd wanted the second run but the fielder is quick to collect the loose ball.
Floated and full, around off. Singh tucks it towards mid-wicket and crosses.
Fuller, on off. Singh pushes it to mid off.
WIDE! This is spilled down leg. Vikramjit Singh looks to chase it but misses. Wide called.
Slower through the air, full and on off. Vikramjit Singh gets on one knee and looks to whip it across the line. He gets an inside edge on his pads.
On off, defended out.
Short and outside off, Vikramjit Singh goes for the cut, gets an outside edge to short-third man for a single.
FOUR! This is pitched up by David Wiese and around off. Vikramjit Singh whips it away well in front of mid-wicket to make it back-to-back boundaries.
Short on the leg-stump, Vikramjit Singh helps it over the fine leg fielder in the circle for a boundary.
Off cutter by David Wiese, kept low as it went through to the keeper.
Full at the stumps, Vikramjit Singh drives it to mid-on.
Short outside off,  Max O'Dowd punches it to point for a single.
David Wiese will share the new ball from the other end.
This one is angled into the pads, Max O'Dowd hangs inside his crease and tucks it to square leg for an easy single.
Floated and full, on off. Vikramjit Singh works it to mid on and crosses for one.
Loops it up, on off, nudged to the leg side.
Vikramjit Singh now opens his account. It is pushed through, wide of off. Vikramjit Singh reaches out and slashes it to sweeper cover. The batters take two before the fielder cuts it out.
Much straighter, on middle and leg. Singh eases it back to the bowler.
Netherlands and Max O'Dowd are off the mark instantly. It is a flatter ball, outside off. Max O'Dowd taps it into covers and gets to the other side.
